public_rationale: On September 16, 2024, Zitron wrote that by Q1 2025 at the latest, Wall Street would begin punishing big tech for its AI spending, far more harshly than NVIDIA. The statement names no measure of punishment, no size, and no window for the comparison with NVIDIA. Any verdict would rest on those choices, which are ours, so the record is kept and not scored.
limitations: This record does not assess how the share prices of Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, or NVIDIA moved between September 2024 and March 2025.
